airtableSync.notes: Optional later sync, off by default. To turn it on: 1) create Airtable tables (or use existing ones) for membership applications and RSVPs, 2) put the table names in joinTable and rsvpTable, 3) set enabled to true, 4) set the AIRTABLE_API_KEY environment variable when you start the server. Never put the API key in this file or in any other file in this folder. The hook lives in server.js as maybeSyncToAirtable().
